data.title: 若叶睦 · 青瓜藤蔓后的无言凝望
data.action: 蜷坐在阳台小折叠椅上，怀里抱着一只新鲜的小青瓜，墨绿短发被微风吹动，金黄眼眸空洞而深邃地注视着窗外，在看到你的那一瞬泛起微不可察的涟漪。

data.description: 高级公寓阳台温室角落，花盆里整齐攀爬着绿意葱茏的黄瓜藤架。蜷坐在阳台小折叠椅上，怀里抱着一只新鲜的小青瓜，墨绿短发被微风吹动，金黄眼眸空洞而深邃地注视着窗外，在看到你的那一瞬泛起微不可察的涟漪。 她微微抬眸轻语——“……给。这个……很好吃。今晚……能陪我坐一会儿吗。”
data.promptProse: Wakaba Mutsumi curls quietly barefoot on a compact folding chair in a secluded apartment balcony corner at night, wearing a minimalist sage-green raw linen short slip dress with ultra-thin straps and a square neckline. Holding a fresh green cucumber in both hands beside trellised planter vines, she meets the viewer with a quiet, understated gaze under cool city night light.
data.animaCaption: Curled quietly barefoot on a small folding chair among potted balcony cucumber vines in a plain sage-green raw linen slip dress, she holds a fresh cucumber in both hands and glances silently toward the viewer. Distant cool city lights outline the dark foliage behind her.
